staleBanner.rootCause: the notice fired on `unavailable.length > 0` while its sentence named positions and minutes specifically. Workflow v0.7.0 gave those two their own paged reads, so the list narrowed to ["events"] — still non-empty, so every sentence gated on its LENGTH kept rendering, now asserting the opposite of the truth. The fix landed on the producer (ingest.ts, unavailableFamilies) and stopped there; four consumers and the field's own doc comment were not carried across, and that doc comment sat two lines above a `readVia` comment that described the new behaviour correctly
staleBanner.whyTheReasonWasFalseFromTheStart: the sentence blamed chain volume — 'those chains exceed the read surface ceiling'. That named a symptom as the cause. The operative cause was that no PAGED read for positions existed, so the only route to them was `export` and `export` has a one-MiB ceiling. When v0.7.0 supplied the paged verbs, nothing about the chains' size changed and the gap closed — which is the proof size was never the cause. Naming a property of the data rather than a gap in our tooling is also why the sentence went unexamined: nobody reopens a question whose stated answer is a law of nature. The same shape was found one layer down in this story and fixed with it — the activity-log notice said the fallback read surface 'has no event verb', which stopped being true when v0.8.0 shipped `event-list`; it now names the real gap, which is that this product's projection does not use it yet
staleBanner.fix: four render sites now ask the family they name, through named helpers (deliberationContentRead / activityLogRead in cockpit-types.ts) rather than a length test: cockpit-views.tsx UnavailableNotice, cockpit-deliberation.tsx threads-unread, cockpit-global.tsx inbox-coverage, cockpit-detail.tsx partial-projection
